title: order

customerEmail.description: Email address of the customer who placed the order, for display.

customerName.description: Full name of the customer who placed the order, for display. Follow the customer link for the customer itself.

datePlaced.description: When the order was placed, as an instant in UTC.

dateUpdated.description: When the order last changed, as an instant in UTC.

address1.description: First line of the street address.

address2.description: Second line of the street address, if any.

deliveryAddress.description: Where the order is to be delivered.

status.description: Where the order is in its lifecycle. The transitions available in the current state are advertised on the order as links and HAL-FORMS templates.

totalPrice.description: Sum of the cost of all line items, in the currency of the product prices.

description: A purchase order. It has no identifier property: the target of its self link is its identity.
